title: Assertions
body: Assertions Assertions retry until they pass or the assertion timeout (5 s by default) expires. No sleeps needed. Inline style page.assertTitle( "Dashboard" ) .assertSee( "Welcome" ) .assertDontSee( "Error" ) .assertPathIs( "/dashboard" ) .assertVisible( "@menu" ) .assertCount( ".todos li", 3 ) .assertValue( "Email", "luis@ortus.com" ) Method Checks assertSee( text ) , assertDontSee( text ) Visible…

title: Testing
body: Testing bx-playwright works in any test framework. TestBox and ColdBox build their browser testing support on the same public API, described in Building on bx-playwright . Using TestBox or ColdBox? Extend testbox.system.BrowserSpec (TestBox 7.2+) or coldbox.system.testing.BrowserTestCase (ColdBox 8.3+). You get browse() , browser matchers such as expect( page ).toSee( "Welcome" ) , screenshots and…

title: CLI
body: CLI bxPlaywright <verb> [options] (or boxlang module:playwright <verb> ). Bash completions are installed with the module. Add --json for machine readable output: only the JSON document goes to standard output (progress and Playwright output go to standard error), and errors are printed as {"error": {"type": "...", "message": "...", "detail": "..."}} .
